d: The United States is reportedly considering the usage of the 'Mother of All Bombs' on Iranian energy infrastructure, including the Pickaxe Mountain. Reports suggest that US President Donald Trump is considering using the GBU-43/B Massive Air Ordnance Blast or MOAB on Iran. The bomb is the most powerful air-launched non-nuclear weapon in US arsenal and is dropped using a C-130 aircraft. The MOAB was tested and inducted in 2003 and was even sent to the Gulf during the 2003 Iraq war, however it was not used in Iraq. The bomb saw its first combat usage during Donald Trump's first term in 2017,…
